mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, bank_account_enc AS bankAccountEnc, bank_account_tail AS bankAccountTail, bank_name AS bankName, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee_bank WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_bank (employee_id, bank_account_enc, bank_account_tail, bank_name) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{bankAccountEnc}, #{bankAccountTail}, #{bankName})
